title: Everyone Recommending It Was the Project
hook: A coding-agent plugin with 66,836 stars keeps arriving as a link. Sorting its evidence by publisher, every source arguing for it belonged to it — the one independent thread was unreachable across five routes, and the claim that decided it came from a vendor with no reason to make it.
for: Anyone asked to adopt an agent tool on the strength of a page the project wrote about itself.
get: A source ledger stamping each claim by who published it, six dead routes to the only independent thread, an adverse-interest claim from the host platform's own docs, and two mechanical checks run against a real machine.
do: Check identity before features, add one column naming who owns each page, and go find the source that loses by saying it.
previewAlt: Demo 12 title slide: everyone recommending it was the project, with the operator's verbatim research request beneath it
